Subject: Request: one-off 75k trial credits for Seedling AI — urgent POC

Team —

Quick background: Seedling AI is an early-stage ML infra startup (Jenna Park, CPO). They signed up via PLG and have been running a small PoC on our hosted API. Usage spiked after integrating streaming; they asked for a temporary bump to run a 30-day enterprise POC that demoed internally to their board next week. HubSpot shows a committed roadmap to convert to Dedicated in Q1 if the PoC succeeds (HubSpot: deals/seedling-7843).

Request: a one-time grant of $75,000 in free credits (platform consumption credits) for a 30-day trial window. This exceeds the default self-serve cap; legal and procurement OK with an MOU (attached quote and MOP). We need leadership sign-off to issue from the Console (manual high-value issuance).

Controls proposed by Sales (recommended):
- 30-day expiration from issuance
- Credits scoped to the account ID only (no cross-account transfer)
- Usage telemetry shared with CSM for quality measurement and to trigger a conversion playbook
- If spend hits >60% in 10 days, auto-notify Sales + Product for throttling conversation

Why this matters: Seedling runs a high-rep throughput workload that will showcase our batching/caching improvements to prospective enterprise buyers in their portfolio. If the POC goes well, the contract is expected to be $250k+ ARR (conservative).

Attachments: seedling_mop.pdf (tech plan), quote_Seedling-Org-2026.pdf (commercial outline).

Ask: Steph/Markus/Laura — please confirm approval (or list conditions) so we can issue the credits and notify Jenna before their board demo on 2026-11-05.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference
